size_basis: study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)
hardware_overshoot_basis: the DN50 schedule rows N1/N2 seat the 60 mm cross-section at the section centre; the 0.15 mm per side sits inside the 1 mm house gate (A-core 2) and is reported here, nothing resized

spool.type: single run, modeled as the in-envelope 1500 mm spool on a 20 mm trough plinth (the HDR_CO2 idiom)
spool.wall_basis: lib/dn Sch 40 table (ASME B36.10M); the node states no schedule (WORK_ORDER W12)
spool.run_basis: the routed run (17.0 m + 9.7 m per AQS-PIP-004) stays in the line-list route lengths; the model draws the in-envelope run
spool.material: PVC-U wetted, per AQS-STD-002 rules M1 and M2. No metal wetted part. The graph gives no temperature for this unit; above 60 °C the thermoplastic is CPVC, never metal. Corrosion allowance does not apply to the polymer.

N1.service: raffinate (EW tail after polish) to continuous recycle
N1.note: schedule row N1 carries DN50: the hardware seats the 60 mm cross-section at the section centre 30 mm (datum 160 predates it; hold, WORK_ORDER W12); DN50 atmospheric tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); the connecting line makes the joint at the face

N2.note: schedule row N2 carries DN50: the hardware seats the 60 mm cross-section at the section centre 30 mm (datum 600 predates it; hold, WORK_ORDER W12); DN50 atmospheric tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); the connecting line makes the joint at the face

N3.note: drain boss, flush at the envelope bottom; 50 datum passes through the section

N4.note: vent, flush at the envelope top (schedule datum 800 is the placeholder above the 60 mm cross-section)

N5.service: Polish bank liquor return to the continuous recycle
N5.note: schedule datum 160 mm is a placeholder above the 60 mm cross-section; clamped down to 48.6 mm (hold, WORK_ORDER W12); DN15 atmospheric tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); the connecting line makes the joint at the face

nozzle_idiom: atmospheric tube stubs flush at the envelope faces (duty section 4: hose, atmospheric; the connecting line makes the joint at the face; the W4 110 percent rule draws no flange where no process pressure is stated); schedule rating column (Class 150) carried verbatim as text; the DN50 hand rows N1/N2 drawn verbatim against the DN15 issued lines (holds, WORK_ORDER W12); DN15 datums clamped into the 60 mm cross-section
